map.CPET 有什么临床价值？: What is the clinical value of CPET?
map.VE/VCO₂ 斜率与 Weber 分级：通气效率斜率 >34–36 提示预后差: VE/VCO₂ slope and the Weber classification: a ventilatory efficiency slope above 34-36 indicates a poor prognosis; combined with VO₂peak it splits heart failure into classes A-D to guide treatment intensity.
map.VO₂peak 与峰值摄氧：运动至极限的摄氧峰值，反映有氧能力，心衰/肺病患者降: VO₂peak and peak oxygen uptake: the peak oxygen uptake reached at maximal exercise. It reflects aerobic capacity, is reduced in heart failure and lung disease, and is an important prognostic and transplant-assessment marker.
map.→ 打开心肺运动试验(CPET)数据分析器工具: -> Open the cardiopulmonary exercise test (CPET) data analyzer tool
map.在递增负荷运动中，当 CO₂ 排出增速超过摄氧增速、RER 接近 1.0 时出现: During an incremental workload test, the breakpoint where CO₂ output rises faster than oxygen uptake and RER approaches 1.0 is the anaerobic threshold, which reflects the upper limit of exercise that can be sustained without relying on lactate. It is often used to set training intensity and is safer than peak values.
map.客观量化运动耐量，鉴别气促源于心/肺/体能；VO₂peak 与 VE/VCO₂: Objectively quantifies exercise capacity and distinguishes whether breathlessness comes from the heart, the lungs or fitness. VO₂peak and the VE/VCO₂ slope are important for heart failure prognosis, transplant timing and pulmonary hypertension risk stratification, and are better than judging on symptoms alone.
map.心肺运动试验(CPET)数据分析器 使用指南: Cardiopulmonary Exercise Test (CPET) Data Analyzer User Guide
map.急性冠脉综合征未稳定、严重主动脉瓣狭窄、未控制心律失常、急性心衰等属禁忌；检查须: Unstable acute coronary syndrome, severe aortic stenosis, uncontrolled arrhythmia, acute heart failure and similar conditions are contraindications; the test must be done in an exercise laboratory with resuscitation capability under the supervision of trained staff.
map.无氧阈怎么测？: How is the anaerobic threshold measured?
map.无氧阈（AT）判定：摄氧随负荷线性上升出现拐点（VCO₂/VE 变化、RER≈1: Determination of the anaerobic threshold (AT): the breakpoint where oxygen uptake stops rising linearly with workload (VCO₂/VE changes, RER≈1.0), representing the ceiling of sustainable aerobic exercise and used to set target intensity.

map.谁不适合做？: Who is it not suitable for?

The tool outputs: Weber class C (VO₂peak 10-16), a ventilatory efficiency deviation (>36), a note of moderate-to-severe aerobic limitation, and a recommendation of low-to-moderate intensity aerobic rehabilitation under supervision with follow-up. Note: this must be performed in an exercise physiology lab by qualified staff.
